notes.subject: le bana ba bona ba tsenang
notes.rationale: ואחיהם is 'their brothers/brethren' — bana ba tsenang ('their counterparts') mirrors the paired-choir sense of לנגדם

notes.subject: משמר לעמת משמר
notes.rationale: 'watch opposite watch' — alternating choir watches; rendered mošomo ka go lelangwa le mošomo to keep the mirrored repetition

notes.subject: משמר...משמר
notes.rationale: the same word frames the verse's end, an envelope structure preserved in Sepedi by repeating mošomo

notes.subject: איש האלהים
notes.rationale: 'man of Elohim' rendered motho wa Elohim literally; no title substitution

translation: Gomme dikgoši tša Balefi: Hhashbhija, Sherbhija le Jeshua mora wa Khadmiele, le bana ba bona ba tsenang, go tšea karolo go hlomoka le go boka, ka taelo ya Dafida motho wa Elohim — mošomo ka go lelangwa le mošomo.
